description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart that displays the proportion of incorrectly answered samples, where the ratio of the co-occurrence of generated entities with question entities (RPop_Ge) is less than the ratio for ground-truth entities (RPop_GT). The horizontal axis categorizes the data by three topics: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the "Ratio (%)" on a scale from 50 to 90. The chart compares three models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). For each topic, the bars show the percentage of incorrect answers where RPop_Ge < RPop_GT. In the "Movies" category, Llama3 and Qwen2 have the highest ratios (approximately 90%), followed by ChatGPT (around 73%). In "Songs", Qwen2 has the highest ratio (approximately 90%), followed by Llama3 (around 85%) and ChatGPT (around 62%). In "Basketball", Llama3 has the highest ratio (around 68%), followed by Qwen2 (around 58%) and ChatGPT (around 61%). The legend is located above the chart.
